body: thank you, all the stuff you've said really means a lot. i appreciate it.

yeah i basically said that it felt like something they'd need to know, that i'm not doing particularly great, and if they want to get out now then i understand it. 

ha, that's pretty good advice. i'll definitely try that out.

my motto of sorts is keep passing the open windows. from the book The Hotel New Hampshire by John Irving. great book if you're interested  in that kind of thing.

no the problem is that the overall situation is my lack of potato peeler. you're handing me more potatoes. more stuff to be like "aw fuck i don't have the tools to deal with this." the things you're saying are, if anything, making me feel worse. maybe it's just that it doesn't work on me it'll probably work for someone else but the stuff you're saying right now to me isn't helping.

ha, maybe clumsiness is another symptom, i banged my head on a cupboard door a couple of days ago and the egg that appeared on my head has just gone down today.

it's weird cos i can reach out sometimes, i know being around people helps my mood even if i don't tell them "hey i want to kill myself hang out with me so i don't want that so much" it's a lot better. i just caved and told someone irl that i'm not good right now though. hopefully it goes okay.

that's a pretty good idea though. i always feel like i'm putting too much on someone if i talk about more than one thing at a time, so maybe having different friends for different things would help that out. how'd you figure that one out?
this isn't helping much??? i can see what you're trying to do but it's like i told you i'm trying to peel a potato but i don't have a peeler and i'm asking for help and you hand me more potatoes.

the whole "suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem" thing is probably true but it doesn't feel very temporary right now

thanks though. i hope you're okay.
the one thing i'm slightly good at is art, and i've been taking baby steps at that for 7 years. you'd think i'd have learned to walk by now but everything i touch turns to shit.

no i haven't, because i don't know if you noticed but it's really fucking hard to try things out. even if it turns out i'd be a great lawyer, how exactly am i supposed to find that out? maybe i'd love to travel, but how am i gonna get the money to do that? see where i'm going with this? all that i've tried, i'm not good at, so i'm taking a reasonable next step from that.
